free_tier.stated: Free users: unlimited tunnels, speed limit varies by tunnel, traffic claimable by daily check-in, Docker supported. [translated from a forum roundup]

interface_detail: frpc plus a web panel, per the roundup.
binding_note: The only metering described is a daily check-in grant of unknown size, so the quota is what would fail first.

identity_cost.detail: Panel registration per the roundup; real-name requirements not stated.

reliability_note: Origin unreachable on the day checked.
confidence_note: The origin returned HTTP 530 on 2026-10-23, which is an origin-side failure, not a challenge. A retry on another day would settle whether this is an outage or a shutdown.

evidence.proved: roundup lists unlimited tunnels and check-in traffic

notes: Recorded because the roundup ranks it, but the site did not answer today. HTTP 530 is Cloudflare reporting an origin DNS or connection failure, which usually means the backend is down rather than the page being blocked. Do not treat this as settled death without a second look.

extras.wg_detail: Nothing could be read from the origin today; the roundup does not say whether UDP tunnels are offered.
